tasks.subject: Task 1: OverrideIdCanonicalizer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** New pure pass that rewrites every item-ID-bearing field in OverriddenSettings to the DB's canonical casing, in place.

**Files:** Create AddMissingQuestRequirements/Pipeline/Override/OverrideIdCanonicalizer.cs; Test AddMissingQuestRequirements.Tests/Pipeline/Override/OverrideIdCanonicalizerTests.cs

**Verify:** dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~OverrideIdCanonicalizerTests"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["AddMissingQuestRequirements/Pipeline/Override/OverrideIdCanonicalizer.cs", "AddMissingQuestRequirements.Tests/Pipeline/Override/OverrideIdCanonicalizerTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~OverrideIdCanonicalizerTests\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["manual override key canonicalized, value preserved", "canBeUsedAs keys and members canonicalized", "quest included/excluded lists and bundles canonicalized, type names untouched", "unknown id passes through", "key collision does not throw"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: DefaultWeaponRules + factory append
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the code-level BoltAction:true -> BoltActionSniperRifle rule and append it to every weapon rule set via the factory.

**Files:** Create AddMissingQuestRequirements/Pipeline/Weapon/DefaultWeaponRules.cs; Modify AddMissingQuestRequirements/Pipeline/Weapon/DefaultWeaponRuleFactory.cs; Test AddMissingQuestRequirements.Tests/Pipeline/Weapon/DefaultWeaponRuleFactoryTests.cs

**Verify:** dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~DefaultWeaponRuleFactoryTests"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["AddMissingQuestRequirements/Pipeline/Weapon/DefaultWeaponRules.cs", "AddMissingQuestRequirements/Pipeline/Weapon/DefaultWeaponRuleFactory.cs", "AddMissingQuestRequirements.Tests/Pipeline/Weapon/DefaultWeaponRuleFactoryTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~DefaultWeaponRuleFactoryTests\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["DefaultWeaponRules.Rules has single BoltActionSniperRifle properties rule", "Build output includes BoltAction rule", "BoltAction item tagged BoltActionSniperRifle with no override"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Inspector consolidation onto the factory
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the Inspector's stale local rule-builder with DefaultWeaponRuleFactory.Build.

**Files:** Modify AddMissingQuestRequirements.Inspector/PipelineRunner.cs; Test AddMissingQuestRequirements.Tests/Inspector/PipelineRunnerRulesTests.cs

**Verify:** dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~PipelineRunnerRulesTests" && dotnet build -c Release

```json:metadata
{"files": ["AddMissingQuestRequirements.Inspector/PipelineRunner.cs", "AddMissingQuestRequirements.Tests/Inspector/PipelineRunnerRulesTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~PipelineRunnerRulesTests\" && dotnet build -c Release", "acceptanceCriteria": ["local BuildDefaultWeaponRules removed", "Run uses DefaultWeaponRuleFactory.Build", "parity test green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Wire canonicalization into both entry points
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Call OverrideIdCanonicalizer.Normalize after override merge in both the SPT loader and the Inspector, before categorization.

**Files:** Modify AddMissingQuestRequirements/Spt/AddMissingQuestRequirementsLoader.cs; Modify AddMissingQuestRequirements.Inspector/PipelineRunner.cs

**Verify:** dotnet build -c Release && dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName!~Integration"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["AddMissingQuestRequirements/Spt/AddMissingQuestRequirementsLoader.cs", "AddMissingQuestRequirements.Inspector/PipelineRunner.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet build -c Release && dotnet test --filter \"FullyQualifiedName!~Integration\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["loader normalizes before ValidateOverrideIds", "PipelineRunner normalizes before categorization", "unit suite green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Version bump + integration smoke
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Bump the mod version to 2.3.0 and add an integration assertion that a real-DB bolt-action gains BoltActionSniperRifle with no override.

**Files:** Modify AddMissingQuestRequirements/Spt/ModMetadata.cs; Modify AddMissingQuestRequirements.Tests/Integration/RealDataSmokeTests.cs; Modify CHANGELOG.md

**Verify:** dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration" && dotnet build -c Release

```json:metadata
{"files": ["AddMissingQuestRequirements/Spt/ModMetadata.cs", "AddMissingQuestRequirements.Tests/Integration/RealDataSmokeTests.cs", "CHANGELOG.md"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test --filter \"Category=Integration\" && dotnet build -c Release", "acceptanceCriteria": ["version is 2.3.0", "integration fact asserts KATT AMR tagged BoltActionSniperRifle, no-ops when slice absent", "CHANGELOG 2.3.0 entry present"]}
```
